newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Robinson sees better full-year result.
newsitem.headline: Robinson sees better full-year result.

text.p: Department stores group Robinson & Co Ltd said on Tuesday it expected its full-year results to be an improvement over the previous full-year.
The company said in a statement with its results for the half-year to December 31, 1996:

"In the absence of unforeseen circumstances, group operating profit is expected to be maintained and, with an anticipated increase in investment income, the current year's result should be an improvement over the previous year."
The company earlier reported a 20.9 percent increase in first-half net profit to Singapore $13.68 million.
